configurationTemplate.loadingMechanism: Process environment through os.Getenv; no automatic .env loading. User must manually export variables before running.

dataPlaneModules.responsibility: Data-plane operations: document loading, Azure OpenAI embedding generation via REST API (no SDK), sequential document insertion via individual CreateItem calls, VectorDistance queries, field name validation

observedContractGaps.observation: Go uses individual sequential CreateItem calls (maxInsertConcurrency=1) instead of TransactionalBatch + goroutines as recommended. The sample works correctly but does not follow the documented insertion pattern.
observedContractGaps.requirement: Go should use TransactionalBatch + goroutines for document insertion per copilot-instructions.md SDK Support table

observedContractGaps.observation: Go hardcodes the Azure OpenAI API version as 2024-02-01 and does not read AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_API_VERSION from the environment. Other languages default to 2024-08-01-preview and allow override.
observedContractGaps.requirement: AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_API_VERSION should be configurable via environment variable

environmentVariableMapping.note: Go does not read AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_API_VERSION from the environment. It uses a hardcoded constant azureOpenAIEmbeddingsAPIVersion = 2024-02-01
environmentVariableMapping.name: AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_API_VERSION

languageDifferences.difference: Go lacks native bulk and uses individual CreateItem calls (maxInsertConcurrency=1). The copilot-instructions.md recommends TransactionalBatch + goroutines but the actual code uses sequential CreateItem.

languageDifferences.difference: Go uses direct REST HTTP calls to the Azure OpenAI embeddings endpoint with bearer token authentication instead of an OpenAI SDK package.
Go hardcodes Azure OpenAI API version as 2024-02-01 and does not read AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_API_VERSION from the environment, unlike Python/TypeScript/Java/.NET which use 2024-08-01-preview.
Go performs a full read-back verification of the created container, checking vector embedding policy and indexing policy. Python does not perform this verification.

controlPlaneModules.responsibility: ARM SDK operations: create and delete SQL containers with vector indexes using armcosmos.SQLResourcesClient. Includes explicit polling intervals, cancellation timeouts, and container verification read-back.

citation.excerpt: CreateContainersWithVectorIndexes creates SQL containers with vector indexes using the ARM SDK

insertionStrategy.approach: Individual sequential CreateItem calls per document with goroutine-based parallelism (maxInsertConcurrency=1, effectively sequential). Each document inserted with partition key set to its Region value.
insertionStrategy.sdkConstraint: Go azcosmos SDK lacks native bulk execution. The copilot-instructions.md recommends TransactionalBatch + goroutines but the actual implementation uses individual CreateItem calls.
